title: Proper cohomology restriction to the closed-point scheme of a weakly contractible test base
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite commutative ring $A$ killed by a power of $\ell$. Let $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\Omega\}$, with the discrete topology for $A$ and the induced $\ell$-adic topology otherwise [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Its condensed ring uses all continuous maps from profinite sets, including when $\Lambda=\Omega$. For a scheme $T$ put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T}$, using ordinary uncompleted module-object derived categories [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] and the small-site/indexing universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal P_T$ be the intersection of all replete classes in $\mathcal A_T$ containing zero and all finite constant scalar-model constructible modules [sk-def-sfb-constructible], closed under kernels and cokernels of maps between members, extensions, and all small ambient coproducts. Extension closure means that in $0\to M'\to M\to M''\to0$ membership of both ends implies membership of the middle. 
Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact scheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], $f:X\to Y$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], and $w:W=\operatorname{Spec}R\to Y$ an affine w-contractible object of $Y_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ [sk-def-pe-wlocal, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $J=\bigcap_{\mathfrak m\text{ maximal}}\mathfrak m$ and $C=\operatorname{Spec}(R/J)$, with its quotient closed immersion $i:C\hookrightarrow W$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Then $C$ is affine, reduced, zero-dimensional and w-contractible, its residue fields are separably closed, and $|C|$ is exactly the closed-point subspace of $|W|$. Put $X_W=X\times_YW$ and $X_C=X\times_YC$, with projection $a:X_C\to X$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every $M\in\mathcal P_X$, the canonical restriction morphism is an isomorphism in $D(\mathbf{Ab})$:
$$R\Gamma(X_W,M)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma((X_C)_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},a^*M).$$
On the left, $X_W\to X$ is an object of $X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ and $R\Gamma(X_W,-)$ means the right derived evaluation functor $N\mapsto N(X_W)$ in $\mathcal A_X$. On the right it means right derived global sections in $\mathcal A_{X_C}$. The map is the derived restriction map induced by the exact module inverse image along $a$, with the pulled-back coefficient identification; it agrees in degree zero with restricting a section from $X_W$ to $X_C$. No completeness of $M$, finite presentation of $f$, invertibility of $\ell$, Noetherianity, or field of definition is assumed. Empty schemes are allowed.
